scope: Post-audit synthesis, card merge/repair, and prose strengthening after TA06/TP production and Claude semantic audit

authority_model.scientific_truth_authority: TA06/TP producer artifacts plus the Claude audit finding set; Probe may not create new scientific truth
probe_may: regenerate only when narrower repair cannot restore coherence
strengthen rhetoric without strengthening epistemic force
retitle within the audited claim boundary
probe_may_not: strengthen causal or certainty language beyond audit authority
drop material qualifiers or limitations without an explicit disposition
silently widen population, setting, comparator, timeframe, or recommendation scope
treat its own rewrite as self-validating

principles.audit_driven: Every substantive repair must bind to an audit finding, claim hook, or explicit package-coverage requirement.
principles.semantic_budget: Rhetoric may change freely inside the audited evidence boundary; epistemic strength may not increase without upstream authority.
principles.package_coverage: The final article+card package must account for material claims and limitations represented in the required coverage set.
principles.edit_locality: Unexpected changed elements are a hard failure unless scope expansion is explicitly authorized and recorded.
principles.independent_gate: Probe emits a transform record; release is determined from declared guards plus deterministic consistency checks, not from prose confidence.

release_rule: PASS only when every hard guard passes, every hard audit finding is resolved, coverage is complete, article rewrite introduces no new claims or material omissions, and every transform operation respects its declared change scope.
non_goal: This contract does not move source discovery, primary scientific audit, or producer-time rendering logic into Probe or TA/TP.
